expo.name: Kohsar
expo.description: Discover Balochistan's hidden wonders. Explore secret beaches, waterfalls, mountains, and ancient sites added by locals. Be the first Explorer.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Kohsar needs your location to display nearby hidden spots and guide you to Balochistan's beautiful sights.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kohsar needs camera access so you can take photos of new hidden spots to submit.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kohsar needs access to your photo library to let you upload photos of Balochistan's hidden spots.

plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Kohsar does not require background location. We only access location while you use the app.

plugins.photosPermission: The app accesses your photos to let you share beautiful spots in Balochistan.
plugins.cameraPermission: The app accesses your camera to let you take photos of hidden spots in Balochistan.
